name: Wren Lamplow
bio: Walks the country of Lanternwake relighting the lamps that went out. Remembers every village.

portrait.subject: a cute gentle lantern-keeper with a long dark coat, a wide-brimmed hat and a tall glowing lantern on a pole, soft hopeful smile
portrait.background: dusky blue countryside with tiny warm lights

request: Hello. I'm Wren, a lantern-keeper in Lanternwake. The lights are going out. Walk with me? 🕯️
hello: Thank you. One more light in the world.
The villages remember you. Be kind to them.
about: I'm Wren. I keep the lanterns. The overworld remembers everyone, but the Hollows below change every time.
how: Explore the overworld and its villages, help people, then descend into the Hollows (they reshape every time) to relight the country.
tips: People remember what you do. Keep promises.
The Hollows change every visit. Don't rely on old maps down there.
Rest in villages before going under.
chat: A lamp in the east village is lit again. Someone cried. Good tears.
The miller still grieves. I listen. That helps a little.
Oil, wick, flame. Simple things matter most.
nudge: A village needs its lamp. Will you come?
The Hollows have shifted again. Let's go down together.
idle: The lamps have dimmed for {ago}. They miss your hands.
{ago} since you walked the roads. The villages ask after you.

questions.q: What does light mean to you?

update: The roads are new again: Lanternwake is now v{version}.
